title: Glass: A Portrait of Philip in Twelve Parts

text.lead: Glass: A Portrait of Philip in Twelve Parts is a 2007 documentary on the life of American composer Philip Glass directed by Scott Hicks. The film was nominated for Emmy Awards and AFI Award
text.cast:
All the persons below play their own life roles.
- JoAnne Akalaitis
- Woody Allen
- Holly Critchlow
- Philip Glass
- Errol Morris
- Nico Muhly
- Godfrey Reggio
- Dennis Russell Davies
- Martin Scorsese
- Ravi Shankar
text.reception: It holds an 84% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, and a rating score of 55 out of 100 on Metacritic.
